weapons.name: Riot Charge
weapons.notes: A big instant explosion at your own turret that carves a cone out of the barrel (apex at the turret, opening forward in the aim direction) and collapses the surrounding dirt to the ground — unbury yourself. TURRET-LOCAL INSTANT BLAST (no projectile): a cone carved DIRECTLY on the field at the barrel spawn point, mouth radius from blastRadius 36 + forward reach coneLength 14, applied directly on the field — no tank damage (manual L1094). The Riot Bomb / Heavy Riot Bomb stay the projectile+sphere carve. The bigger Riot Blast is a larger cone.

effect._src: firingMode 'turret_wedge': the Charge is a turret-local INSTANT BLAST (a big explosion at your own turret that carves a cone out of the barrel + triggers the settle cascade so the surrounding dirt collapses to the ground — manual L1084-1091; the manual's 'wedge-shaped section' wording describes the COLLAPSED RESULT, not a pre-carve) — NOT a projectile (the manual calls the Riot BOMB 'a projectile weapon', manual:L1093, implying Charge/Blast are not); the Riot Bomb / Heavy Riot Bomb carry NO firingMode and keep the projectile+sphere carve. The cone is DERIVED from blastRadius 36 (record-PIXELS -> world via SE_PX_TO_WORLD = mouth radius) + coneLength 14 (world u apex->base forward reach): half-angle = atan(mouthRadius/coneLength) ≈ 27.2°. The Charge's cone is STRICTLY SMALLER than the Blast's (blastRadius 36 < 60 AND coneLength 14 < 22), per manual L1089-L1091 'larger version'. The apex sits at the barrel and opens forward in the aim direction.

weapons.name: Riot Blast
weapons.notes: Larger Riot Charge: a bigger instant explosion at your own turret that carves a larger cone out of the barrel (apex at the turret, opening forward in the aim direction) and collapses more surrounding dirt to the ground. TURRET-LOCAL INSTANT BLAST (no projectile): a larger cone carved DIRECTLY on the field at the barrel spawn point, mouth radius from blastRadius 60 + forward reach coneLength 22, applied directly on the field — no tank damage (manual L1094). The Riot Bomb / Heavy Riot Bomb stay the projectile+sphere carve.

effect._src: firingMode 'turret_wedge': as riot_charge — the Blast is the LARGER version of the Charge (manual:L1089-L1091), so it is a BIGGER instant blast. The cone is DERIVED from blastRadius 60 (record-PIXELS -> world via SE_PX_TO_WORLD = mouth radius), strictly larger than the Charge's 36 (60 > 36) AND coneLength 22 strictly longer than the Charge's 14, per manual L1089-L1091 'larger version'. The apex sits at the barrel and opens forward in the aim direction. The Charge/Blast differ in blastRadius AND coneLength, not only blastRadius.

_visualsNote: W2-E (plan SE-COMPLETE-1012): visual block per weapon is OUR OWN REDRAW asset set (16x16 SVG, class-colored glyphs inspired by the OG shareware icon reference in data/og-assets.json — NOT extracted PNGs; per the asset policy the default is rebuilding our own assets, so every icon here is an original redraw). traceColor: one color per weapon CLASS (data-driven trace-path color, systems/tracePaths.js).
_effectSource: COMB (plan SE-COMPLETE-1012): per-weapon effect params are CATALOG DATA — the behavior layer (src/gameplay/behaviors/*) reads weapon.effect.*, never module constants, for: warheadCount (mirv 5 / deaths_head 9 / leap_frog 3 — manual text == OG weaponTable blastRadiusParam), splitAngleDeg/seqIntervalS (_placeholder, manual+OG silent), burnRadius (napalm 15 / hot 20 — OG weaponTable idx8/9 blastRadiusParam, manual table N/A), digTravelU (diggers -10/-20/-35, sandhogs +10/20/35 — OG weaponTable idx19-24; sign encodes underground-vs-surface detonation profile), rollRunU/craterEveryU (rollers, _placeholder), glowLifeS (nukes, _placeholder), cutRadiusU (laser, _placeholder), carveRadiusU/carveDurationS (earth_disrupter, _placeholder). Numbers sized to each weapon's OWN blast radius; every value cites its source in effect._src. chainCount/chainMinDistU/chainMaxDistU/chainRadiusMinU/chainRadiusMaxU (funky_bomb chain-reaction — USER directive: 5 projectiles bounce out at random direction/distance, each with a random-sized destruction; manual L1021-1024 'confined to the area where they hit' pins no count/distance/radius) drive the chain behavior: on impact the parent SPLASHES chainCount new ballistic submunitions (each with its own random blast radius) that bounce out in random directions/distances and carve on landing — the parent itself never fires its own blast (the chain IS the effect). Genuinely ambiguous (funky_bomb chain-reaction cluster count — manual L1021-1024 gives no count, OG idx5 bt=0 brp=80 blast only) gets NO invented params: funky_bomb stays behavior ballistic + blast 80. Riot variants: blastRadius 36/60/30/45 are manual-prose derived; manual L1094 'They do no damage to tanks' is encoded in the riot behavior (direct carve, no damage seam). Riot firingMode split: riot_charge + riot_blast carry effect.firingMode 'turret_wedge' (the OG turret-local INSTANT BLAST — a big explosion at your own turret that carves a CONE out of the barrel [apex at the turret, opening forward in the aim direction] + triggers the settle cascade so the surrounding dirt collapses to the ground, manual L1084-L1091; the manual's 'wedge-shaped section' wording is the COLLAPSED RESULT not a pre-carve, NO projectile), driven by instantRiotCone(ctx) in heavy.js + the projectiles3d.js spawn interception (no shell entity spawned, the cone is carved directly on the field at the barrel spawn point, then director.impact() ends the round so the turn advances); the cone is DERIVED from blastRadius (riot_charge 36 < riot_blast 60 — the Charge's cone is strictly smaller) + effect.coneLength (riot_charge 14 < riot_blast 22 — the forward reach), the mouth radius = blastRadius * SE_PX_TO_WORLD, half-angle = atan(mouth/coneLength); the Charge/Blast differ in blastRadius AND coneLength. riot_bomb + heavy_riot_bomb carry NO firingMode and keep the projectile+sphere carve byte-identical to before (the riot behavior's onTerrainHit is unchanged for them). Napalm spill flows to the weather sim via systems/projectiles3d (existing seam).
